capabilities: Compute degree, betweenness, closeness, and eigenvector centrality for the vault graph
Render the vault as an interactive force-directed graph with centrality-based sizing and coloring
Generate AI summaries, keywords, and knowledge domains for each note
Identify knowledge bridges, foundations, authorities, gaps, and suggested connections
Write AI-recommended [[links]] into notes and track vault evolution over time
extras: Desktop only (no mobile support); requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. AI features send note text to Google Gemini under the user's own API key, with free-tier limits of 250K TPM and 500 requests/day; graph computation is fully local.
motivation: The author says knowledge internalization becomes the bottleneck as note volume grows, and that making sense of a large vault needs graph structure and AI working together rather than either alone.
problem: Large, fast-growing vaults can no longer be understood by manual browsing, and Obsidian offers no way to see which notes are structurally load-bearing or where the network has gaps.
summary: Vault analysis plugin that computes graph centrality metrics locally via Rust WASM and sends them to Google Gemini for structural AI analysis.
